watches.description: Back to the Coast. This maritime motif seamlessly fuses mechanics and aesthetics, turning the case back into a true highlight.

watches.name: Naos Moonphase Edition Neuwerk
watches.description: Moved by the moon. Inspired by Neuwerk. With the Naos Moonphase Edition Neuwerk, our most popular watch collection receives a special edition. It combines the clean design language of the Naos with a moon phase and calendar display, while capturing the history of a place that, like few others, stands for orientation, constancy, and the rhythm of nature. Neuwerk, Hamburg's oldest landmark, has been guiding ships into the Elbe River for over 700 years. At the same time, the island remains deeply connected to the changing tides: accessible on foot at low tide, surrounded by water at high tide. It is precisely this connection between the moon, time, and nature that makes the Edition Neuwerk so unique. The anthracite, slightly domed dial with a fine sunburst finish creates a vivid play of depth and reflections depending on the light. Orange Luminova luminous dots set striking accents and, together with the luminous hour and minute hands, ensure excellent legibility at night. The silver and turquoise needle hands pick up the colors of water, sky, and navigation, giving the watch its distinctive character. At 6 o'clock, the moon phase display shows the constant changing of the moon. Its cycle from new moon to full moon and back to new moon takes 29.5 days—and has always influenced the low and high tides. A date display complements the dial at 3 o'clock, while the day of the week is displayed at 9 o'clock. The Naos Moonphase Edition Neuwerk is powered by the reliable Miyota 6P20 quartz movement.

The aircraft was named "Bremen, " after the Hanseatic city that has stood for discovery and the spirit of exploration for centuries. This special edition captures that pioneering character and translates it into a refined, precision-driven design. The striking signal red dial and white needle hands create a bold visual statement, giving the timepiece a distinct and modern presence. Clean Lines, Bold Presence With a 38 mm diameter and a case height of just 6 mm, the Naos Edition Bremen remains exceptionally slim and elegant on the wrist. The polished 316L stainless steel case provides a premium feel, while the double-domed, double-AR-coated sapphire crystal ensures maximum legibility. The signal red dial creates a powerful contrast against the white needle hands, emphasizing the watch's clean, contemporary character. The date window at 6 o'clock is color-matched to blend seamlessly into the dial, maintaining a calm and balanced aesthetic. Reliable Engineering Meets Historical Heritage Powering the watch is the proven Ronda 714 quartz movement, known for its precision and everyday reliability. The case is water-resistant up to 5 bar and protected by a four-fold screwed stainless steel case back. The back features an exclusive edition engraving that commemorates the story of the legendary "Bremen" and underscores the watch's pioneering soul. Combining a robust stainless steel case with high-grade sapphire crystal, this timepiece perfectly merges historical inspiration with modern technology. Special Edition Strap with a Bold Accent The Naos Edition Bremen is paired with an exclusive special edition strap made of black bovine leather. The red contrast stitching mirrors the dial’s color, creating a striking accent that harmoniously completes the design. Thanks to the integrated quick-release spring bars, the strap can be changed in seconds without any tools – offering maximum versatility for your daily life.

The 4-times screwed case back features a special Neuwerk edition engraving , permanently capturing the origin of this edition. With water resistance up to 5 bar , the Hamburg Chrono Edition Neuwerk is designed to be a durable companion for everyday life.

watches.description: A Timepiece with Depth – Inspired by the Historic Old Elbe Tunnel The Hamburg Edition 1911 pays tribute to one of Hamburg’s most iconic engineering achievements: the Old Elbe Tunnel, inaugurated in 1911. For over a century, this tunnel has connected the banks of the Elbe River – a lasting symbol of technical innovation, progress, and Hamburg’s identity as a proud port and trading city. This timepiece captures the atmosphere and history of this architectural marvel in every design detail. Design Rooted in History The dark blue satin-finished dial evokes the depths of the Elbe, while a fine light blue chapter ring adds structure and dimension – like the glimmer of light at the end of the tunnel. Gold-toned hour and minute hands contrast with the signal orange seconds hand , a nod to the bold industrial color schemes of the early 20th century. For perfect legibility in low light, orange Luminova dots and luminous hands ensure visibility even in darkness. The double-domed sapphire crystal , with anti-reflective coating on both sides, protects the dial from scratches and glare. At 42 mm , the stainless-steel case houses a reliable Miyota quartz movement – robust, low-maintenance, and ready for everyday wear. Water-resistant to 5 ATM , it’s splash-proof but not suitable for swimming. Caseback Engraving – A Scene Full of History The four-screw caseback features a detailed engraving depicting workers walking through the newly opened Elbe Tunnel in the early 1900s – a quiet tribute to the men who brought this engineering feat to life.

It is nearly dark when a sailor trudges in from the docks. The streets beneath his feet feel strange—it's the first time in weeks he has set foot on solid ground. Weeks spent with nothing but the rocking of the ship and the howling wind as his constant companions. Weeks in which the unbroken, endless blue of the ocean was all he could see. But now, he is back. Home. He pauses briefly, letting his gaze sweep across the dimly lit streets of his hometown—the city he has missed so much while at sea. Not everything looks the same. A new building stands here, a different-colored facade there. A new shop has opened on the corner, and the gentlemen’s fashion has changed.

watches.description: Revive the Roaring Twenties with the Naos Edition Cambridge The Golden Twenties. The automobile was no longer a novelty. Bauhaus replaced the ornate Art Nouveau style. Jazz was the music of the day. Jazz was the music of the day. The Flapper Girls around Josephine Baker enchanted their audience. New courage to live, freedom, lightness. The heyday of the industrial age. Stock market boom. Even the fashion became more relaxed. Heavy leather boots became lightweight footwear. Knickerbockers and flat caps found their way into every man's wardrobe. The only missing accessory was the right timepiece! The New Era of Watches The golden decade was a pivotal moment for watchmaking in terms of technology. In 1924, the English watchmaker John Harwood patented the first automatic watch. Just three years later, Joseph Horton, together with American engineer Warren Marrison, invented the quartz watch and presented it at the conference of the International Union of Scientific Radio Telegraphy. The uniqueness: its impressive accuracy . While the commercialization of the quartz watch didn't happen until the 1960s, the essential foundation was laid much earlier. The fashion style characterised by class and the new glamour of the 1920s inspired us in creating our latest timepiece . Following on from last year's automatic version, the limited Naos Edition Cambridge comes with a precise quartz movement . Since the 1920s, the technology has been developed further and further, and the quartz watch offers many advantages: reliability, precision, durability , reduced susceptibility to interference and the price making it the first choice for many watch enthusiasts. Perfect for the golden season: Naos Edition Cambridge in the distinctive "British Racing Green" colour. We celebrate the Roaring Twenties and the upcoming golden season with the new edition of the STERNGLAS classic. The Naos Edition Cambridge is limited to only 999 pieces and equipped with the reliable Ronda calibre 714 from the Swiss manufacturer. The domed dial with subtle satin-finish in the colour " British Racing Green " perfectly matches the polished, gold-coloured 38 mm stainless steel case . Other highlights include the gold date frame and orange accents on the hands. The 4-fold screwed caseback shows the noble edition engraving "Racing" with a vintage sports car and of course the limitation number, which makes each piece unique. For decades, the unmistakable " British Racing Green " colour adorned British sports cars on famous racetracks. In exactly this livery, Briton William Grover-William won the first Monaco Grand Prix in 1929 almost 100 years ago in his Bugatti Type 35 C. watches.name: Berlin sepia gold
watches.description: Vintage meets minimalist design to create a timepiece with a unique look and feel for the model Berlin. The dial is limited to the essentials , but offers displays for the date and weekdays (German) . The strap made of cowhide leather has a noble alligator imprint that makes the model an eye-catcher on your wrist. The caseback of the 10 mm high case is decorated with an engraving of the Berlin railway station in our home town of Hamburg. After its construction in 1857, it was the westernmost terminus of the railway connection between the two cities for 46 years. Inside, the quartz movement by Miyota works just as reliably as the first steam locomotive that brought its passengers safely from Berlin to Hamburg. Although much more quietly. Promised. And the glass? Sapphire glass , of course. Absolutely scratch-resistant in everyday situations. Double anti-reflective coating and curved for optimal readability. Discover more about the story. watches.name: Kanton 2.0 silver / black
watches.description: Also available with brown leather strap. Go to Kanton 2.0 silver / brown . The Kanton combines the STERNGLAS-typical Bauhaus aesthetic with Swiss precision. We present our most sophisticated model to date: the STERNGLAS Kanton. Made in Switzerland following Swiss Made standards, the automatic watch impresses with a classic yet modern appearance. Excellent readability thanks to the strong contrasts clearly show the source of inspiration: the design language of Bauhaus. The finely domed and satin-finished dial emphasises the elegant-classic character of the watch. Inside of the watch, the Swiss Sellita SW200 movement ensures precision with an accuracy of mere +/- 7 seconds a day. The movement with a gold engraved rotor can be examined through the sapphire glass case back . The Swiss Made Kanton 2.0 arrives in a high-quality oak veneer watch box . The longer you look at this little treasure, the more details you will discover. At first glance, it appears to be merely a simple, classic Bauhaus-style watch that is timeless and a sight to behold on any occasion. Upon closer inspection, however, the Kanton 2.0 unfolds a veritable treasure trove of design and craftsmanship details that will make the heart of any watch lover beat faster. This model is made in Switzerland. watches.name: Levin
watches.description: Bauhaus meets Memphis design. Our inspiration for the LEVIN was the eye-catching Memphis design . This 80's design aesthetic features bright colors and intertwined shapes and lines . Combined with the simple Bauhaus design that characterizes all STERNGLAS timepieces, the LEVIN was born. The high-character dial impresses with rich blue and turquoise highlights . The dial is rounded off by the red second hand and the silver-white needle hands . The black cowhide leather strap with turquoise stitching and red loop perfectly sets off the dial on any wrist. Thanks to the quick-change system , the new strap can be changed easily and without tools within seconds. The case is made of polished 316L stainless steel , has a diameter of 40 mm and a height of only 7 mm. In the interior of the timepiece is the proven 3-hand quartz movement caliber GM12 from the Japanese traditional manufacturer Miyota. The dial is protected by domed, double anti-reflective and scratch-resistant sapphire glass . A special highlight is the Memphis x Bauhaus engraving on the back of the case. This shows the typical Bauhaus shapes circle, square, triangle in a modified Memphis design interpretation. UNIQUE A captivating color-combination that makes you stand out of the crowd. FUNCTIONAL Perfect readability thanks to coloured hands & high contrasts. In addition, an interchangeable strap with quick-change system – for changing the strap without tools. DURABLE Equipped with a durable Miyota quartz movement and sapphire glass – the best watch glass in the world. SECURE With a water resistance of 5 ATM, it can withstand the demands of everyday life. watches.name: Naos XS Edition Flora terracotta
watches.description: The STERNGLAS women's collection welcomes a new, feminine model variant: the Naos XS Edition Flora in the color "terracotta". The polished 33 mm case is 6 millimeters high. It is gently rounded and lies comfortably around the wrist. That way, the dimensions and design provide a classic and feminine profile. 5 ATM water resistance protects the case from moisture and fogging when wearing the timepiece everyday. Like all STERNGLAS timepieces, this edition has a domed, double anti-reflective sapphire glass that provides the best readability with extreme scratch resistance . The leather straps are color-matched tone-in-tone to the dials and are manufactured in a traditional German workshop. The model is delicately decorated with a floral edition engraving on the back of the case, which gives the design its flowery name. The Edition Flora can also be combined with a Milanaise strap with a 16 mm lug, leaving further options open for matching the look of the timepiece to your mood and outfit. watches.name: Marus
watches.description: With the Marus , we present our first automatic watch with a rotating bezel and a water resistance of up to 20 ATM . Inspired by classic diving watches, it is designed for everyday use as well as for the next adventure. Of course, we only use stainless steel so that the watch is not affected by water corrosion. To achieve a particularly high water resistance, the case back and the crown are screwed down . The domed sapphire glass has a double anti-reflective coating and is particularly scratch-resistant. This guarantees a clear view of the dial. For perfect readability, the indices and hands are also equipped with Nemoto Luminova . So you can read the time even in the dark. Visual highlight on the back: the engraving of an abstract seabed .
